questions.question: Which language should the Vue frontend use?
questions.rationale: Vue is specified; TypeScript is recommended for a large, role-rich enterprise application.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Adds static typing and safer refactoring for a large Vue application.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Uses standard JavaScript without static type checking.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?
What should the frontend include?
questions.answer: Implement the full requested HRM module list with polished, responsive dashboards and workflows; role-specific HR, manager, and employee experiences; accessible forms, tables, calendars, reports, and document views; and a visual direction informed by the Frappe HR reference without assuming unverified product details.
questions.rationale: The user requested a professional, visually stunning application and supplied a detailed HRM module specification and reference.
questions.recommendedChoice: Implement the full requested HRM module list with polished, responsive dashboards and workflows; role-specific HR, manager, and employee experiences; accessible forms, tables, calendars, reports, and document views; and a visual direction informed by the Frappe HR reference without assuming unverified product details.
